name: Vaultback
silhouette: Long-legged crab with a high open shell vault above a visible abdomen and broad under-body gap.
motion: Broad sideways strut; chooses a side, raises the rear legs, intercepts and lowers the vault.

name: Clipmantis
silhouette: Upright thin mantis with triangular expressive head, large aimed eyes, long forearms and four fine walking legs.
motion: Measures a short stalk, aims both eyes, opens its forearms and closes a clear startup arc.

name: Foilscythe
silhouette: Tall mantis with broad crescent forearm foils, long folded abdomen and subordinate close-held wings.
motion: Measured high-knee stalk; unfolds facing foils, watches the crossing and closes them slowly.

name: Swaylemur
silhouette: Long-tailed tree mammal with round forward eyes, plain large ears, small hands and two leaf-like tail tufts.
motion: Sways its tail while watching a route; plants a small decoy, leans aside and gathers its hands.

name: Canopetail
silhouette: Tall long-forearmed tree mammal suspended below a raised tail loop with broad separated leaf tufts.
motion: Counterbalanced steps; reaches toward two endpoints, raises its tail loop and recoils after activation.

name: Rillnewt
silhouette: Low newt with a broad smiling mouth, four widely planted toes and a long flat tail.
motion: Swaying knuckle crawl; lifts its smiling face, splays toes and sweeps a small fork with its tail.

name: Veilcrest
silhouette: Lifted-elbow newt with a transparent continuous dorsal veil and broad foreleg frills.
motion: Raises its elbows and veil; turns its head through a crescent, then lowers the frills.

name: Glimmerbat
silhouette: Fruit-bat-like mammal with large ears, short bright muzzle, connected wing fingers and tucked tail.
motion: Quick flap-hang pauses; ears aim at a target, muzzle brightens and wings fold after marking.

name: Flarefan
silhouette: Broad-winged bat with fingers fanning into a shallow W silhouette above long landing toes.
motion: Lands on long hind toes, fans linked wing fingers toward two marks and slowly folds its wings.

name: Needletrot
silhouette: Long-snouted tenrec-like mammal with focused small eyes, rounded ears, short legs and low quill crest.
motion: Quick nosing trot; aims its snout, banks one spine and shakes the crest into place.

name: Quillstride
silhouette: Slim living quilled mammal with long rear legs and an open fan of separately readable metallic spines.
motion: Rises onto its rear legs, pivots an open quill fan, recalls it and settles its changed center of gravity.

name: Screepeek
silhouette: A stocky tapir with a short mobile trunk, small round ears, heavy hindquarters and three pale pebble pads along its shoulder.
motion: Slow alternating four-foot stroll; trunk probes ahead on the idle beat.

name: Stairtrunk
silhouette: A long-trunked tapir with stepped flaring ears, high shoulders and low hindquarters, leaving a clear diagonal back silhouette.
motion: Forefoot reach, trunk curl, broad rear step; ears fold on recovery.

name: Mossmarch
silhouette: A short six-legged caterpillar-like animal with a square muzzle, four separated moss cushions and a bare expressive brow.
motion: Six legs ripple in three pairs while cushions squash in sequence.

name: Trellislong
silhouette: A long high-arched six-legged crawler with an open lattice of connected moss ribs above its smooth living underside and wide face.
motion: Three alternating leg pairs carry a traveling body arch, never a static stretched base sprite.

name: Dripurchin
silhouette: A low sea-urchin-like animal with a soft visible face, five blunt movable spines and three rounded tube feet.
motion: Rotates its feet without rotating its face, then bobs with gathered droplets.

name: Dewmedusa
silhouette: A tall soft-bodied urchin with its five spines opened into curved umbrella ribs and long joined tube-foot tassels; face hangs below the cap.
motion: Gentle pulse-lift then trailing-foot settle; a grounded shadow makes its location legible.

name: Stilltide Orrery
silhouette: Three independent water arcs revolve around a small dark pebble, with a clear central void and no animal head.
motion: Each arc slows separately when absorbing a shot, then realigns into a quiet orbit.
role: Legendary projectile defense and delayed counterplay
